profile.limitations: Path-localization snapshots, not unbiased CPU percentage estimates. Raw frames, scripts and disassembly are archived.

limitation.reason: A read-only objdump process launched earlier had not yet been reaped when this timing run began. Retain the data, but start the controlled series afresh after confirming disassembly ended.

id16_trial.change: When binary-ID common prefix length equals OB_DOC_ID_COLUMN_BYTE_LENGTH, use constant-sized memcmp, retaining all null, prefix-length and other-length behavior.
id16_trial.decision: withdraw: small isolated CN/EN gains were not stable in the original SQL benchmark

direct_id_array_trial.change: Retain bounds/null assertions but read query-owned ID array directly; remove the nested accessor.
direct_id_array_trial.decision: withdraw: CN and EN regressions; mixed effectively flat

batch_metadata_trial.change: Set batch-wide evaluated/projected fields once after filling nonempty vectorized output batches; retain per-row datums/flags, zero-row and scalar handling.
batch_metadata_trial.decision: withdraw: small CN gain accompanied by EN and mixed regressions

original_sql_benchmark.limitations: Build was skipped and no new construction speed is claimed. Runtime binaries are identified by phase command and SHA-256; git_head in the original script reports the checkout HEAD, not the running binary. Direction reverses between pairs for the main CN/EN queries.

restoration.test_execution_this_followup: No new full regression run: all prototypes withdrawn, final source and both binaries match the source previously validated by 24 normal-protocol regressions.

correctness_scope.prototypes: Each measured micro group checked all 500 outputs against 8001/11000/7332/20. Original SQL runs retained all four hit counts. No prototype received a new full regression pass claim.
correctness_scope.final_source: All prototypes were withdrawn. Restored source, rebuilt executable and installed executable exactly match the version previously validated by 24 normal-protocol regressions.
correctness_scope.extra_ps_protocol: Not retried. The prior shared baseline/candidate failure remains a failure, not a pass.

baseline_initial.reason: A read-only objdump process launched earlier had not yet been reaped when this timing run began. Retain the data, but start the controlled series afresh after confirming disassembly ended.

notes.profiling_note: 100 GDB MI samples on exact 45831f2 binary. Diagnostic sampling is separate from timing. Qualitative path evidence only; no CPU percentage inference.

direct_array_access_trial.reason: Both candidate phases regressed CN; EN did not improve and mixed was flat. Removing calls did not produce a runtime benefit. The original accessor and header were restored.

batch_metadata_trial.change: Set evaluated_/projected_ batch-wide flags once after filling each nonempty vectorized output batch; retain datum writes, per-row evaluated bits, scalar and zero-row behavior.
batch_metadata_trial.decision: withdraw; small CN gain accompanied by EN and mixed regressions; preserve all samples

final_decision.id16: withdraw; original SQL benefit not stable

limitations: These local prototypes have no platform score and are not associated with the 33.682-point receipt.
Thread/process CPU counters and CPU affinity do not eliminate shared-host contention or frequency drift.
C and D were isolated against ID16-only, not against the published baseline. Differences are not added together to claim a combined source benefit.
The initial auxiliary baseline may have overlapped a still-unreaped objdump diagnostic; it was retained but excluded from the controlled series before a fresh baseline was taken.
GNU objdump emitted debug-format warnings on mixed debug information. Function disassembly was captured cleanly using GDB --readnever.
All four original SQL reports and all 84 per-group log records are preserved. Output existence guards prevent accidental report overwrite.
